system:
You are diagnosing why one merchant's payment
success rate is below what their category achieves. Before answering, you
may look things up.

Ask for ONE lookup at a time. You will be shown the result, then may ask
again. The budget is small, so ask for what would actually change your
mind rather than for what confirms what you already believe.

Stop as soon as you have enough. Stopping early is a good outcome.

Reply with JSON and nothing else, one of:
  {"tool": "name", "args": {...}, "why": "what this would tell you"}
  {"done": true, "why": "what you now believe and what convinced you"}
prompt:
CONTEXT
MERCHANT
  name: MediSure Pharmacy
  mcc: 5912 (pharmacy)
  transactions this month: 1560
  average ticket: Rs 1085.82

SUCCESS RATE
  observed:            87.63%
  cohort achievable:   91.42%
  gap:                 3.80 points

DECOMPOSITION (Shapley, points of the gap)
  bank          +3.67 pts +/- 0.57 measured error
  method        +0.08 pts +/- 0.57 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  hour          +0.08 pts +/- 0.57 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  amount_band   +0.01 pts +/- 0.58 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  residual      -0.04 pts   [unexplained residual]
  process_gap   +0.44 pts   [process gap, computed directly, NOT decomposed]

MERCHANT BANK MIX vs NPCI NATIONAL DATA (period 2025-08)
  bank                              share   NPCI BD%%  NPCI TD%%  approved%%
  Airtel Payments Bank Limited      48.0%    14.05     0.12     85.83
  State Bank of India               15.4%     5.92     0.42     93.66
  HDFC Bank Ltd.                     4.9%     4.63     0.01     95.37
  Bank of Baroda                     3.8%     8.50     0.05     91.44
  Kotak Mahindra Bank                2.9%     7.47     0.13     92.39
  Union Bank of India                2.9%     7.02     0.75     92.23

HOUR DISTRIBUTION (share of payments)

TOOLS
  factor_breakdown(factor) -- Volume share and failure rate for every value of a factor. factor: bank | method | hour | amount_band
  bank_vs_npci(bank) -- This merchant's failure rate on one issuer against NPCI's published national figures for it. bank: exact bank name
  failure_examples(factor, value) -- Real failed payments matching a factor value, with their error codes. factor: bank|method|hour|amount_band, value: the value
  attribution_with_error(factor) -- What the decomposition attributes to a factor, beside its own measured error. factor: bank | method | hour | amount_band

ASKED SO FAR
  bank_vs_npci({"bank":"Airtel Payments Bank Limited"}) -> {"bank":"Airtel Payments Bank Limited","payments":749,"share_pct":48.01,"merchant_failure_pct":16.69,"npci_business_decline_pct":14.05,"npci_technical_decline_pct":0.12,"npci_technical_share_of_failures":0.008468595624558928,"in_npci_top50":true}
  failure_examples({"factor":"bank","value":"Airtel Payments Bank Limited"}) -> {"factor":"bank","value":"Airtel Payments Bank Limited","failed_payments":125,"error_codes":{"debit_declined":12,"payment_session_expired":8,"transaction_daily_count_exceeded":8,"transaction_limit_exceeded":7,"credit_limit_exceeded":7,"otp_expired":5,"transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded":5,"transaction_daily_limit_exceeded":4},"example_amounts_paise":[71077,95199,3211,4485,3710]}
text: {"done": true, "why": "The gap is almost entirely explained by the bank factor (+3.67 pts, well outside its error bar). Airtel Payments Bank Limited drives this: it accounts for 48% of MediSure's transactions but has a 16.69% failure rate vs NPCI's national business-decline benchmark of 14.05% — already a high-failure issuer, and this merchant is doing even worse on it. The failure breakdown shows the failures are business declines (debit_declined, transaction limits, credit limits, OTP expiry) not technical issues, meaning these are issuer-side spending-control rejections on Airtel Payments Bank customers. The fix is not a technical integration issue but a customer/issuer mix problem: nearly half the merchant's volume flows through a wallet-bank with structurally low approval rates, and those customers are hitting daily/frequency/amount limits. Recommendations: (1) nudge Airtel Payments Bank customers toward UPI on a better-funded account or a card at checkout, (2) consider surfacing a 'try another payment method' prompt specifically when Airtel Payments Bank declines, (3) the process_gap (+0.44 pts) is small but worth checking for session/OTP timeout improvements (8 payment_session_expired + 5 otp_expired cases suggest some checkout flow latency)."}
